second.text:
Your plate-pool lives at **https://joeuk89.github.io/plate-pool/**

Each of your routines carries a ready-made link that opens it with the bar or dumbbell already loaded to that day's weight using your home plates — so for the deadlift, for example, you tap the link and it shows you exactly which plates to put on for 140.5 lb. There's also a separate "set up the home kit" link that fills in your full plate inventory, which is the one to use on a fresh device before the loader links will know what you own.

Want me to paste the inventory-setup link here? It's long, but handy to have to hand.
